messages:
inc-bot: ALERT 1778888888 — P99 latency elevated on batch-service-us-east-1. Trigger: svc.batch.generate.p99 > 1000ms for 4m. Possible impact to /v1/stream and /v1/generate endpoints. Paging on-call.

liam: I'm oncall. jumping in. quick glance: sudden influx of tiny requests from sdk-v1 that bypass batching heuristics. avg payload size ~120 bytes.

priya: confirmed — packet capture shows a mobile SDK bug sending repeated short chat-completions (n=3 rapid retries). Burst is keeping batch workers busy with small batches; head-of-line blocking increases tail.

zara: customer-facing symptoms: slow initial stream start, time-to-first-byte high, some spurious 502s when worker queues fill. CS reported multiple tickets from mobile-beta group.

liam: mitigation proposal A (fast): increase continuous_batching.window_ms to 250 on east batch pools, and raise min_batch_size=8 to avoid too-small batches. Proposal B (aggressive): temporarily disable streaming for non-sla tenants (fall back to non-streaming responses) — reduces concurrency pressure. Also add temporary token-bucket throttle for sdk-v1 group (rps cap 50).

priya: prefer A + token-bucket. disabling streaming will impact product experience a lot. we can keep streaming for SLA tenants only.

liam: ok split work. I'll patch runtime-config for pool batch-us-east-1 and add inflight caps. Priya take the quota/rate changes. Zara coordinate CS messages.

liam: applying runtime patch now — runtime-control API. payload: ```json
{"pool":"batch-us-east-1","continuous_batching":{"window_ms":250,"min_batch_size":8,"max_batch_size":128},"max_inflight_small_batches":6}
```

opsbot: runtime-config apply job queued (job rc-9913).

priya: updating quota/rate rule for sdk-v1 group: ```bash
curl -s -XPOST https://control.redwood.internal/v1/rate-limits/update \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"client_group":"sdk-v1","limit_rps":50,"scope":"global","reason":"tmp mitigation 1778888888"}'
```

opsbot: rate-limit update accepted, rule id rl-4421.

zara: CS note drafted: "We observed increased latency affecting mobile-beta clients. We applied traffic shaping and batching adjustments to restore stability; some non-SLA mobile calls may see shorter streams or slightly higher latency while we stabilize. We will follow up with postmortem." Sending to affected customers now.

liam: rolling change completed. watching metrics: queue_depth us-east batch nodes from 3900 -> 900 within 75s. p99 dropped from 1.3s -> 480ms.

priya: initial error spikes subsiding. sdk-v1 throttle currently at 45 rps average, peaks trimmed.

liam: note: one pod restarted during config reload (batch-worker-7). opsbot shows healthy restart and caught up.

opsbot: pod batch-worker-7 restarted by rc-9913 at 2024-09-17T02:15:34Z, restart reason: configReload.

zara: CS update: customers acknowledged and seeing improvement. No new tickets in the last 10m.

liam: handoff: Priya you're primary for next 45m. I'll monitor dashboards but switching to sleep shift. Please escalate to infra if we see queue depth > 1500 again.

priya: taking over. I'll leave a pinned watch in the incident ticket with thresholds and grafana links: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/batch-east?from=now-30m&to=now

liam: follow-ups: 1) hotfix to SDK to stop rapid-retry loop, 2) add server-side heuristic to detect pathological small-request bursts and auto-increase batching window, 3) postmortem with mobile SDK team. I'll file RFC to make safer defaults for min_batch_size.

zara: opened INC-1778888888 for customer outreach and postmortem. cs-bot created outreach campaign.

cs-bot: Ticket INC-1778888888 created and assigned to zara.

liam: great work. closing page alert on my side. keeping watch for 30m then move to follow-up triage.

priya: milestone: p99 stable ~460ms for 10m, error rate <0.4%. Scheduling 1h canary to test same config in eu-west-1 before any global rollout.

opsbot: alert cleared for svc.batch.generate.p99 in us-east-1 at 02:22:10Z.

zara: thanks team. summary posted to incident doc and added action items. we'll sync with mobile eng tomorrow 08:00 UTC.
